motifs.name: material surplus
motifs.description: The side to move has at least a pawn of material advantage, with a small bonus for the bishop pair.
motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'material surplus'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has at least a pawn of material advantage, with a small bonus for the bishop pair.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    vals = {
        chess.PAWN: 100,
        chess.KNIGHT: 320,
        chess.BISHOP: 330,
        chess.ROOK: 500,
        chess.QUEEN: 900,
    }
    score = 0
    for pt, v in vals.items():
        score += v * (len(board.pieces(pt, stm)) - len(board.pieces(pt, opp)))
    if len(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, stm)) >= 2:
        score += 40
    if len(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, opp)) >= 2:
        score -= 40
    return score >= 100
